good_thing: (New Zealand): The official population of critically endangered kākāpō reached a recovery-era high of 325 birds on September 1. Ninety chicks from the 2026 breeding season joined the count after the youngest surviving chick reached 150 days old, the point at which it is considered fledged and independent enough to be counted.
current_or_history: On September 10, 1846, Elias Howe Jr. received U.S. Patent No. 4,750 for his lockstitch sewing machine. Howe had watched his wife sew for others by hand while money was scarce; his design used an eye-pointed needle and a shuttle to interlock two threads.
tiny_fact: Koalas have human-like fingerprints, along with multiple opposable thumbs on each hand.
thought: You do not have to make every ordinary day prove its worth.
